2607.28449.title: Lightning OPD 2.0: Mitigating Style Bias in Cross-Teacher On-Policy Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
2607.28449.paper_summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense token-level supervision from a teacher, but its effectiveness can depend on teacher consistency, meaning that the model providing OPD supervision should also have generated the demonstrations used to train the supervised fine-tuning (SFT) reference. However, this condition is frequently violated in practice when SFT data have mixed or unknown provenance or when different models are preferred for SFT data generation and subsequent distillation. In such cross-teacher settings, even a stronger OPD teacher can yield little improvement over the SFT reference. We find that raw teacher--reference disagreement contains potentially useful context-specific teacher evidence as well as a recurring component associated with differences in wording, formatting, and reasoning cadence. We introduce Lightning OPD 2.0 with cross-fitted style residualization, which uses rollout-level cross-fitting to estimate this recurring component as an operational proxy for style-token bias and subtracts it before constructing the token-level OPD update. Across mathematical reasoning and code generation benchmarks, Lightning OPD 2.0 consistently outperforms Lightning OPD in cross-teacher settings. Starting from Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT, Lightning OPD 2.0 reaches 82.4% on AIME 2024 and 63.0% on LiveCodeBench v5. Together, these results establish Lightning OPD 2.0 as a practical approach to cross-teacher OPD, relaxing teacher consistency as a prerequisite and allowing the SFT data generator and distillation teacher to be selected independently. Code will be released soon.
2607.28449.paper_summary_zh: 在政策蒸餾（OPD）中，教師提供了密集的標記級別監督，但其有效性可能取決於教師的一致性，這意味著提供 OPD 監督的模型也應該生成用於訓練監督微調（SFT）參考的示範。然而，當 SFT 數據具有混合或未知來源，或當不同模型被偏好用於 SFT 數據生成和隨後的蒸餾時，這一條件在實踐中經常被違反。在這種跨教師的情況下，即使是一個更強的 OPD 教師也可能對 SFT 參考的改進有限。我們發現原始教師與參考之間的不一致包含潛在有用的上下文特定教師證據，以及與措辭、格式和推理節奏差異相關的重複組件。我們介紹了具有交叉擬合風格殘差化的 Lightning OPD 2.0，該方法使用回合級別的交叉擬合來估計這一重複組件，作為風格標記偏差的操作代理，並在構建標記級別的 OPD 更新之前將其減去。在數學推理和代碼生成基準測試中，Lightning OPD 2.0 在跨教師設置中始終優於 Lightning OPD。從 Klear-Reasoner-8B-SFT 開始，Lightning OPD 2.0 在 AIME 2024 上達到 82.4%，在 LiveCodeBench v5 上達到 63.0%。這些結果共同確立了 Lightning OPD 2.0 作為一種實用的跨教師 OPD 方法，放寬了教師一致性作為前提條件，並允許獨立選擇 SFT 數據生成器和蒸餾教師。代碼將很快發布。
